description: cfd_2d_nwt with the one-step scheme (N 40 1): the Godunov convection (godunov) of the momentum and the level set, one projection per step, the level set moved with the projected velocity after the projection. Over 20 s the gauges within 0.8 % of RK3 at 3 times less wall time (validation 73).
covers: momentum_rk with one stage (N 40 1), the order momentum, projection, level set
godunov: momentum (ipol 1, 3) and level set (ipol 4) on a uniform grid
